title: The price of a 3-room apartment in Bucharest starts at 151,000 euros plus VAT
description: Discover the real price grid for 3-room apartments in Bucharest, starting at 151,000 euros plus VAT, with transparent down payment and parking details.

lead: When you search for the price of a 3-room apartment in Bucharest, you encounter thousands of listings, each with its own story. One source gives you an average, another measures something else, and none tells you exactly how much cash you will spend on a property you can actually visit. Let us take a specific apartment. Ilioara Residence is located on Aleea Eprubetei, in the Titan Dristor area, offering 3-room units priced between 151,000 and 168,000 euros plus VAT. We will calculate the VAT, down payment, and parking costs for both ends of this price range, and then compare them with market conditions in the autumn of 2026.

sections.h2: City averages contradict each other, and that helps you

blocks.x: The Imobiliare.ro index recorded Bucharest at 2,250 euros per usable square meter at the end of the first quarter of 2026, with the northern areas exceeding 5,000 euros and the southern areas dropping below 1,500 euros. In April 2026, Credite.cc gathered 3-room listings ranging between 120,000 and 220,000 euros, resulting in an average of 155,000 euros. Listing averages do not represent a signing price: they show where the market stands, not what you actually pay for a specific building.

Averages also shift depending on how you measure them. In September 2026, hartapreturilor.ro analyzed 361 listings from Imobiliare.ro and Storia.ro, arriving at 1,869 euros per square meter, which is lower than the spring index. This is not a contradiction, but rather the result of different counting methods capturing different listings. This is why a transparent price grid for a specific, visitable building tells you much more than any market average.

sections.h2: At Ilioara Residence the price is clearly stated, with VAT calculated on the spot

blocks.x: The entry-level 3-room apartment costs 151,000 euros plus VAT, while the larger option goes up to 168,000 euros plus VAT. The VAT rate is 21 percent. Doing the math transparently brings the totals to 182,710 euros and 203,280 euros, respectively, with VAT included. The larger unit offers a total area of 86.1 square meters, combining usable space and terrace, while the entire 3-room layout range spans between 49 and 86 square meters. The same April analysis places new 3-room properties in Bucharest between 75 and 95 square meters, placing the larger option on the generous side of the spectrum.
The building has a ground floor plus 8 stories, with 4 apartments per level and a single 3-room unit on each floor, totaling 35 units. The complete price grid saves you from any guesswork.

sections.h2: The difference between 2 and 3 rooms is worth 43,500 euros

blocks.x: Two-room apartments start at 107,500 euros and go up to 136,500 euros, both prices excluding VAT. From the most affordable 2-room apartment to the most affordable 3-room unit, the gap is 43,500 euros plus VAT. For this amount, you gain an extra room: a home office, a child's bedroom, or a guest room for visiting parents. If you have not decided which side of the price gap you prefer, the available apartments page shows you real options for both layouts.

sections.h2: Day one of payments: reservation and a 30 percent down payment

blocks.x: To reserve an apartment in your name, you sign a reservation agreement for 2,000 euros plus VAT. The minimum required down payment is 30 percent of the price, which amounts to 45,300 euros for the entry-level unit, calculated on the price without VAT. The remaining balance until handover comes from a mortgage loan or personal savings. If you choose a mortgage, our mortgage guide outlines what the bank requires and when.

sections.h2: Parking is paid separately, and there is no buyer commission

blocks.x: Parking spaces are optional: 20,000 euros plus VAT for a standard single space, and 25,000 euros plus VAT for a double Klauss parking system. If you prefer not to buy one, the first 3 clients can rent a space starting at 80 euros plus VAT per month. Regarding paperwork, the notary prepares the contract, the bank requests a property valuation, and land registry extracts bring minor additional fees. You pay these costs only once, at contract signing. There is no buyer commission because you purchase directly from the developer.

sections.h2: Titan Dristor allows you to buy below northern Bucharest prices

blocks.x: The April 2026 market analysis places older apartment blocks in District 3 between 125,000 and 165,000 euros, while new developments range between 155,000 and 210,000 euros. Ilioara Residence, offering 3-room units between 151,000 and 168,000 euros plus VAT, sits comfortably within the new build price bracket at southeastern rates, far below the 5,000 euros per square meter seen in the north. The market is rising behind you: the index recorded a 15 percent growth over 12 months, and new apartments appreciated by 24 percent annually, compared to 14 percent for older blocks.

The location also makes daily commuting convenient: 7 to 11 Aleea Eprubetei places you a 5-minute walk from Nicolae Grigorescu subway station, 9 minutes from IOR Park, and 15 minutes from ParkLake Mall.

sections.h2: Check the price grid and remaining apartments before visiting

blocks.x: The building is scheduled for delivery in December 2026, meaning you buy before construction is finalized. You select your unit on the architectural plans and verify it on site. You can check how many apartments remain available on the available apartments page, right next to the price grid. Do your math at home with the figures on your screen, and then verify everything in person on Eprubetei Street.

New developments in District 3 range between 155,000 and 210,000 euros according to the April 2026 analysis, placing the project right in the middle of local pricing.

faq.a: On average, yes. The Imobiliare.ro index recorded southern Bucharest below 1,500 euros per square meter at the end of the first quarter of 2026, while the north exceeded 5,000 euros. In District 3, older apartments range from 125,000 to 165,000 euros, and new ones from 155,000 to 210,000 euros. Keep in mind that averages vary between sources: a September 2026 count of 361 listings reached 1,869 euros per square meter, staying below the spring index. Averages place you on the map, but the project price grid tells you exactly how much cash you need.
